description: Paper-1 WP2 joint four-hull evaluation: a small complete bridge (4 hulls x {168,288,504} epochs x 3 diagnostic strata x 20 census-selected paired seeds), a joint-outcome pilot on independently sampled evaluation seeds, and a reproduction arm. Design: campaigns/noro/paper1_joint_eval_01/DESIGN.md.

selection_rule.census: 1 epoch, 100 agents, baseline block, arm station_lots (adds no key), worker tools/noro_diag/supply_seed_scan.py
selection_rule.sampling_frame: per hull, the 20,000 consecutive census seeds; a seed is one voyage draw under the baseline block
selection_rule.burden: sum over provisioned_lot objects of lot_servings * lot_titre_gec_per_g * 150 g
selection_rule.diagnostic_outbreak: 20 contaminated seeds of highest burden (ties: lower seed)
selection_rule.diagnostic_near: 20 contaminated seeds of lowest burden (ties: lower seed), disjoint from outbreak
selection_rule.evaluation: per source stratum, the 20 frame seeds of lowest sha256('noro_paper1_joint_eval_01:<seed>') -- an equal-probability sample without replacement; inclusion probability n_s / N_s and weight N_s / n_s are written to seed_selection.json
selection_rule.pairing: one diagnostic seed list per hull and stratum, reused at 168/288/504
selection_rule.status: diagnostic seeds are purposive and carry no population weight; only evaluation seeds support population estimates
selection_rule.shortfall: a stratum the fixed census cannot fill is run at its achieved count and reported; the census is not extended and no seed is hand-picked

technical_completion.intended_inputs_used: every archive: voyage length equals the tier's epochs, PYTHONHASHSEED recorded as 1, arm changed_paths equal the declaration, effective config resolved with no mismatch, effective hash equals the manifest tier's, intended role counts on initialised agents and in the payload, engine commit recorded and single-valued per tier
technical_completion.attempts_accounted: the seeds read are exactly the tier's seeds, each once; a failed child is listed with its reason, retried at most once on the same seed, never replaced by a new seed
technical_completion.pairs_meaningful: within hull and stratum the three lengths hold the same seed set and all three are read; the reproduction arm is compared seed by seed

diagnostic_bands.cell_in: quiet <= quiet_max, outbreak >= outbreak_min, and quiet < near < outbreak with near inside [near_min, near_max]
diagnostic_bands.cell_out: an interval excludes its band: quiet lower bound > quiet_max, outbreak upper bound < outbreak_min, or the near interval lies wholly outside [near_min, near_max]
diagnostic_bands.hull_status: in if all three lengths are in; out if any length is out; otherwise undetermined

continuation.precondition: evaluated only when technical completion holds
continuation.justified_defect_fix: the reproduction arm does not reproduce, or an input check failed. Requires a named defect with paired-seed evidence before any fix; never opened by an outcome alone
continuation.population_geometry: some hulls are out and others are not (includes a zero-event large hull)
continuation.uncertainty: no hull is out and at least one is undetermined
continuation.precision: every hull is in: allocate replication from the pilots

precision.zero_event_convention: k = 0 of n: exact (Clopper-Pearson) one-sided 95% upper bound 1 - 0.05^(1/n); 0/300 -> 0.994%, 0/20 -> 13.9%. Stated with its sampling frame: hull, voyage length, source stratum, census seed range
precision.bridge_n20: two-sided 95% half-width about +/-0.23 at a rate of 0.5; the bridge resolves ordering, not rates

targets.posting_probability: two-sided 95% half-width <= 0.10 per hull x length (about 100 seeds near 0.5)
targets.quiet_bound: one-sided 95% upper bound <= 1% (300 zero-event evaluation seeds in the uncontaminated stratum)
targets.size_tail: tail frequencies from >= 1,000 seeds per cell
targets.curves_environment: descriptive (median and IQR of timing); no precision target

precision.allocation: per hull, Neyman allocation across source strata from the pilot: n_s proportional to W_s * sqrt(p_s(1-p_s)), W_s = N_s / N from the census; a stratum with p_s = 0 in the pilot is sized by the quiet_bound target
precision.population_estimate: stratified (Horvitz-Thompson) over evaluation seeds: sum_s W_s * p_s; diagnostic seeds are excluded
precision.temporal_pilot: from the bridge's paired lengths: if every 504-epoch run's role-report series is bit-identical over its first 168 and 288 epochs to the same seed's shorter runs, replication runs 504 only and truncates; otherwise each length is replicated
precision.batches: bridge, pilot and each replication block are fixed-size batches declared before submission; a batch is analysed once, when every child is accounted for; no interim look changes a batch size and earlier batches are not re-analysed under new rules
